coverage: TfL road-camera views in London.

refresh_or_rate_notes: TfL describes approximately 2–3 minute image updates; not a guaranteed live-video cadence.

limitations: Views may be interrupted for traffic management, maintenance or system failure. Example XML in the guide is not the live feed.

verification_scope: Public publication/docs reviewed; no camera-by-camera uptime test or complete camera export.
